Exam Practice

Exam Scripts: Robots and the CPU

Year 11

What to do: learn real Paper 1 answers by writing them. Go to the next slide and start.

  • Each script is a short exam answer from a real mark scheme: robots, sensors and AI, and the CPU and the fetch-decode-execute cycle.
  • First you copy the answer. Each time you get full marks, you get less help, until you write it in a blank box.
  • If you miss a mark point, you see what the mark needs, and some help comes back.
  • A script is secure when you write it from a blank box twice, with other scripts in between.
  • Keep going until every script is secure. Your progress is saved, so you can stop and come back on any computer.
